statement: For ANY g:[K]^r->[-1,1], let G_g(x)=E g(Z1,...,Zr) with conditional IID Cat(x) labels. It is degree r. For tangent increments h_j with zero coordinate sum and l<=r, |D^l G_g(x)[h1,...,hl]|<=(r)_l product||h_j||1.
